rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for being capable, skillful, or generally clever.

example.english: They’re really clever at fixing things.

rows.note: Choose this for intellectual ability, especially learning and understanding quickly, rather than practical skill.

example.english: My little sister is very clever at learning new things.
example.jyutping: aa3 mui6 hok6 je5 hou2 cung1 ming4

rows.note: Use this when someone is shrewd or when an idea, method, or trick is smart and effective.

example.english: This money-saving method is really clever.
example.traditional: 呢個慳錢方法真係醒目。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haan1 cin2 fong1 faat3 zan1 hai6 sing2 muk6

rows.note: Use this for the witty, sharp, or ingenious quality of a remark or piece of writing.

example.english: This article is written in a clever and forceful style.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章寫得精警有力。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 zing1 ging2 jau5 lik6
